properties.otherAdvice:
A temporary pedestrian bridge will be built across Macquarie St to facilitate the safe movement of participants for the Sydney Marathon event on the weekend of 30-31 August.

Macquarie St will be closed between Bridge St and Bent St to allow for the installation and then removal of the temporary bridge. Once installed, the bridge will have a height clearance of 4.6 metres.

Overnight full and/or lane closures will be in place at the following times:

  • Fri 22 Aug: Full closure from 11pm until 7am (Sat 23 Aug)
  • Sat 23 Aug: Full closure from 11pm until 7am (Sun 24 Aug)
  • *Sun 24 Aug: Full closure from 10pm until 5am (Mon 24)
  • Sun 31 Aug: Full closure from 6pm until 4am (Mon 1 Sep)
  • Mon 1 Sep: One of two southbound lanes closed from 10pm until 5am (Tue 2 Sep)
  • *Tue 2 Sep: One of two southbound lanes closed from 10pm until 5am (Wed 3 Sep)*

When the full closures are in place, motorists will be detoured via Bridge St, Phillip St and Bent St.

Some parking spaces will be removed from Macquarie St during bridge installation and removal.

*Closure only implemented if required.
